source: type Upper = <T extends string>(x: T) => Uppercase<T>; type Sharp = (x: "ßfoo") => "SSFOO"; type Wrong = (x: "ßfoo") => "ßFOO"; interface View<T> { value: { [K in keyof T as Uppercase<K & string>]: T[K] }; keys: keyof { [K in keyof T as Uppercase<K & string>]: T[K] } } type Native = View<{ a: number; A: string; "ß": boolean; SS: number }>; type Plain = { value: { A: number | string; SS: number | boolean }; keys: "A" | "SS" };
